summary.headline: Planetary Perambulations and Climacterics
summary.text: Astrological prognostication by perambulations of the ascendant, Venus, and Mars, assigning years and months to bodily illness, climacterics, death, benefits, marriage, honor, and service to learned persons. The calculations use planetary terms, trine, diameter, square, conjunction, profection, and hexagon relationships.
